description: This file defines the class FormatWithAchievement, which implements the ValueFormatter interface, providing a method to format achievement-related values into display strings based on predefined constants.

classes.name: FormatWithAchievement
classes.description: A class providing formatted string representations for achievement statuses, implementing the ValueFormatter interface.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns a display string ('Positive' or 'Negative') based on the achievement value ($entityValue). Returns null for unrecognized values.
